# Historical Equihash fixture

`zcl-webgpu1927.txt` contains three serialized 543-byte headers: the same
140-byte Zclassic mainnet header, canonical CompactSize `fd9001`, and three
different 400-byte Equihash 192,7 proofs. They were generated by the WebGPU
solver in https://github.com/netzo92/zclthesis-webminer (core commit `f82d0da`).

The fixed header comes from block 3192878,
`00000c55116b591143fdea1cbf2568b885207fb61c3d1aeb549b3c15937b0c58`,
read using Zclassic v2.1.2-beta6 RPC. One generated proof exactly reproduces
that mainnet block. The other proofs satisfy Equihash for the same header;
this fixture does not claim that their full hashes meet the block difficulty.

The webminer repository retains the original RPC provenance, GPU results,
JavaScript verifier and independent Python hashlib verifier. This test adds
the pool's production C++/libsodium verifier and rejects mutations to the
solution, nonce and personalization. It never searches for new proofs or
connects to a live pool.

On Ubuntu with `build-essential` and `libsodium-dev` installed:

```sh
bash stratum/tests/run-equihash1927.sh
```

This command passed on the project's Ubuntu 24.04 CPU host with AddressSanitizer
and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer enabled: all three proofs accepted, all nine
mutations rejected. The inherited verifier emits compiler warnings about its
diagnostic format strings; no sanitizer failure occurred in these fixed cases.
